description: Source code for the implementation of CU-UP (CU User Plane) component, including setup, connection management, and shutdown routines for a 5G network element.

classes.name: cu_up
classes.description: Main class implementing CU-UP functionality, managing GTP-U sessions, E1AP, and control routines.

methods.name: cu_up
methods.description: Constructor initializing CU-UP with configuration and dependencies, setting up GTP-U, E1AP, and session management.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts CU-UP, establishing connections, and initiating setup routines.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops CU-UP, terminating sessions and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: handle_stop_command
methods.description: Asynchronous routine to handle shutdown procedures, including stopping CU-UP manager and timers.

methods.name: on_statistics_report_timer_expired
methods.description: Logs current statistics and restarts the reporting timer.
